services.name: Premium Cabins
services.desc: Our private, fully-furnished valley rim cabins offer a unique way to experience Monument Valley. Many have said the view from the cabins is actually better than the view from the hotel rooms. Each cabin features a private porch that overlooks the valley and is decorated in an old west decor. Each cabin also has a full restroom and shower plus refrigerator and microwave. The Premium cabins are more private and secluded than our hotel rooms. services.name: Navajo Guided Tours
services.desc: Stay at the Hotel or in one of our Cabins to guarantee the ability to book a guided tour into the valley! The number of daily tours will be limited, and the only way to guarantee you are allowed to book a tour is by staying with us. We highly recommend booking your stay with us, and then booking a tour in advance. Be one of the first visitors to return to Our Beautiful park and actually take a tour into the valley.
